test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Sometimes, she passes **__sarcastic__** remarks on everyone.
solution: The correct answer is **"Hostile."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Sarcastic"** means using irony to mock or convey contempt. (व्‍यंग्‍यात्‍मक) • **Example**: *She made a **sarcastic__** comment.* • **"Hostile"** means unfriendly or antagonistic, which can be a form of contempt. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति अत्‍यंत उग्र भावनाओं वाला; प्रतिकूल भाव) __ • **Example**: *That was a **hostile**__ crowd.* • Therefore, **hostile **is the most appropriate synonym for **sarcastic** in this sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Quite** means to a certain extent or degree, which does not convey the same meaning as sarcastic. (अधिक नहीं; किसी हदतक; अपेक्षाकृत) • **Exceptional** means unusual or extraordinary, which is not related to sarcastic remarks. (बहुत असाधारण; असामान्‍य रूप से अच्‍छा) • **Complimentary** means expressing praise or admiration, which is the opposite of sarcastic. (प्रशंसात्‍मक; सम्‍मानसूचक) 43:Tae9, The correct answer is **"CEBDA."**
